status.en: 402 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 18% fewer than the week before, most of them in Delhi, Mumbai and Hyderabad.
status.nb: 402 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 18 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Delhi, Mumbai og Hyderabad.

summary.en: Security forces in Manipur seized a Kuki-Zo insurgent camp, arrested a KNF (MC) cadre and a Kuki militant, and recovered foreign-made weapons, firearms, grenades and ammunition, while the Manipur chief minister linked the violence to a pervasive gun culture and urged surrender of illegal arms. In Jammu and Kashmir, the lieutenant governor chaired unified command meetings reviewing the security situation, and the IGP called for action against over-ground workers and hybrid terrorists, while arrests were made for leaking sensitive security information to foreign handlers. The UCDP recorded 437 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Sikkerhetsstyrker i Manipur beslagla en Kuki-Zo-opprørsleir, arresterte en KNF (MC)‑medarbeider og en Kuki-militant, og gjenvant utenlandske våpen, skytevåpen, granater og ammunisjon, mens Manipur-statsministeren knyttet volden til en gjennomgripende våpenkultur og oppfordret til overgivelse av ulovlige våpen. I Jammu og Kashmir ledet lederen for unionsterritoriet felles kommandomøter som gjennomgikk sikkerhetssituasjonen, og IGP ba om tiltak mot over-grunnsarbeidere og hybride terrorister, mens arrestasjoner ble gjort for lekkasje av sensitiv sikkerhetsinformasjon til utenlandske håndterere. UCDP registrerte 437 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Kashmir conflict
background.extract: The Kashmir conflict is a territorial conflict over the Kashmir region, primarily between India and Pakistan, and also between China and India in the northeastern portion of the region. The conflict started after the partition of India in 1947 as both India and Pakistan claimed the entirety of the former princely state of Jammu and Kashmir. It is a dispute over the region that escalated into three wars between India and Pakistan and several other armed skirmishes. India controls approximately 55% of the land area of the region that includes Jammu, the Kashmir Valley, most of Ladakh, the Siachen Glacier, and 70% of its population; Pakistan controls approximately 30% of the land area that includes Azad Kashmir and Gilgit-Baltistan; and China controls the remaining 15% of the land area that includes the Aksai Chin region, the mostly uninhabited Trans-Karakoram Tract, and part of the Demchok sector.
